description: List the products (Matanot) of one rikma for the merchant: name, price, pricing mode, status, archived, kind, quantity (-1 = unlimited), lowStockAt, stockTotal, hasVariants, and each variant (sku, price, quant, active, axisKey). This is the seller view used by the sales/manage tabs (moachShopProducts) — not the public catalog. Members only. Call it first to see what you have on the shelf before creating, editing stock or checking orders. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#listRikmaProductsTool

includeArchived.description: Also return archived products. Default false.

kindOf.description: Filter by kindOf: total, monthly, yearly, daily, unlimited.

name: listRikmaProductsTool
